service "hellohttp" {
  image = "joonas/hellohttp"
  version = "v2"
  replicas = null
  how_to_update = "parallel-one-at-a-time"
  restart_policy = "on-failure"
  ingress_public {
    port = 80
    rule = "HostRegexp:hellohttp.com"
  }
  net {
    mode = "host"
  }
  ram_mb = 16
}

-------------
services:
  hellohttp:
    deploy:
      labels:
        edgerouter.auth: public
        traefik.frontend.rule: HostRegexp:hellohttp.com
        traefik.port: "80"
      update_config:
        parallelism: 1
        order: start-first
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: "16777216"
    environment:
      LOGGER_SUPPRESS_TIMESTAMPS: "1"
    image: joonas/hellohttp:v2
    labels:
      edgerouter.auth: public
      traefik.frontend.rule: HostRegexp:hellohttp.com
      traefik.port: "80"
    network_mode: host
    restart: on-failure
